record.institution: City Colleges of Chicago - Harold Washington College
record.segment: Public community college; 5,000-9,999 enrollment band based on FY2024 total unduplicated enrollment; Chicago, Illinois
facts_carried_over: Kim Bowens is Dean of Enrollment Management and a member of the Harold Washington College cabinet. Source: Harold Washington College Cabinet Members page; accessed 2026-09-15.

Bowens leads the admissions unit and is listed with Early College and international-student responsibilities. Source: Harold Washington College Admissions, Early College, and International Students pages; accessed 2026-09-15.

Harold Washington College reported 8,865 total unduplicated enrollment, 8,451 credit-seeking students, 1,494 Early College students, and 70% fall-to-spring retention in FY2024. Source: HWC FY2024 Fact Sheet; 2024-10-30. Possibly stale.

City Colleges' 2026-2030 plan prioritizes a cohesive digital student experience, personalized student support, coordinated systems, retention, and data-informed continuous improvement. Source: City Colleges of Chicago 2026-2030 Strategic Plan; 2026-03-05.

Current public IT documentation names D2L Brightspace, PeopleSoft administration, Salesforce, Oracle RightNow, Microsoft 365, and district data/integration functions. Source: City Colleges of Chicago Information Technology page; accessed 2026-09-15.

Current public leadership pages name Daniel López as President, Ming Geng as Vice President of Finance and Operations, Luvia Moreno as Vice President of Student Affairs, August Kampf-Lassin as Director of Research and Planning, Jay Agarwal as Chief Information Officer, and Keith Moore as Harold Washington College IT Director. Source: official CCC leadership and IT pages; accessed 2026-09-15.
